balance_boundary.scope: This is a sharp boundary for the uniform ten-moment design only; weighted/adaptive variants remain open.
balance_boundary.statement: For five nonnegative factor exponents summing to 5, every cube-two/square-three moment has length exponent at most 12 iff all five exponents equal 1.
balance_boundary.unbalanced_countermodel: (1/2,1/2,1,3/2,3/2) has moment lengths ranging from 11 to 13.

claim_boundary: Conditional on a sum of subpower-many balanced fivefold products with the frozen coefficient-square norms, this artifact proves the local critical row exponent 36/5 and gain 4/5. It does not construct the source factorization, prove a new zeta density estimate, improve a uniform density coefficient or prime interval, close a left neighborhood, prove Base/CRR incompatibility, or extend an L-function family.

conditional_anchor_map.boundary: Pointwise conditional anchor only; not a uniform density or interval theorem.

conditional_local_theorem.route: ten-colour geometric-mean selection followed by the discrete mean-value theorem at length H=v^12

conditional_on: The relevant critical detector is a sum of v^o(1) products of five length-v^(1+o(1)) Dirichlet polynomials.
Each of the ten cube-two/square-three moment polynomials has coefficient square norm at most v^(12+o(1)).
The rows are one-separated in an interval of length v^12 and the component selection loses only v^o(1).

density_effect.statement: The source factorization and left-neighborhood/global-envelope gates are open.

symbolic_balance.proof: If every pair sum is at most 2, their average 2 forces every pair sum to equal 2; comparing pairs with one common index forces all five exponents equal, hence each is 1.

fractional_tensor.identity: For ten two-subsets S, geometric_mean_S |prod_(j in S)A_j^3 prod_(j notin S)A_j^2|=|prod_j A_j|^(12/5).
fractional_tensor.length: Five balanced length-v factors give moment length v^12, exactly the local time scale H.
fractional_tensor.selection: At every row, one of ten integer-power moments is at least |A|^(12/5).

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: source inspection, exact combinatorics and exponent algebra, registered rational balance enumeration, replay, and tamper rejection

source_factorization.adverse_cases: rough/prime-dominated integers, power-many product components, coefficient multiplicity, or an unavoidable moment length v^(12+kappa)
source_factorization.target: Decompose the critical normalized Type-I detector into v^o(1) balanced fivefold products with divisor-bounded convolution coefficients.
